_comment_place_order: Master safety switch. true: BUY the selected option on entry and SELL it when SL or target_exit hits (and at the 14:50 force exit / end of day). false: paper-trade only, no orders. Applies to LIVE and LIVE test mode, never BACKTEST.
_comment_target_exit: Which of Exit1-1 also triggers the SELL, in addition to SL (SL always does). One of: null, "exit1", "exit2", "exit3", "exit4". null means only SL (or the 14:50 force exit) sells.
_comment_order_type: Order type for the BUY (entry) and SELL (exit) orders. One of: "MARKET", "LIMIT", "SL" (stop-limit), "SL-M" (stop-market).
_comment_limit_buffer_percent: LIMIT and SL orders only: how far the limit price sits from the option's reference price (its LTP at the signal). BUY: price = ref + buffer%; SELL: price = ref - buffer%. A larger buffer fills more reliably but at a worse price.
_comment_trigger: SL and SL-M orders only: the trigger price is the option's reference price itself.
